headline: Congress renamed the post office at 303 East Mississippi Avenue in Elwood, Illinois, after Lawrence M. "Larry" Walsh Sr.
what_it_does: This law officially names the United States Postal Service facility at 303 East Mississippi Avenue in Elwood, Illinois, the "Lawrence M. 'Larry' Walsh Sr. Post Office." It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, mail delivery, or the building's operations.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 19, 2022, and the name applies from that date.
